changelog:
Added
- Edge Mode: the device cuts out or slows at random intervals, then eases back. Works in freestyle and with funscripts.
- Edge counter on every photo, gallery and creator.
- Hotkeys: rebind global shortcuts in Settings.
- Slideshows now end on a "Keep going?" screen — 6 choices, pick one with a number key.
- Hall of Fame is a league table: green/red arrows show places gained or lost.
- Stats modals for galleries and for individual photos and videos.
- "See all" opens the full ranking for each Hall of Fame section.
- Clear all creators from selected galleries or photos in one click.
- Settings > Scanner: read video lengths for older imports.

Changed
- Creators and Card Collection filters now live in the URL — shareable, bookmarkable, with a Reset button and real pagination.
- Hall of Fame now counts photo views and how long you linger on them.
- Slideshow crossfades between photos.

Fixed
- Creators: sorting by Most Photos or Most Cummed was broken and effectively random.
- Card Collection: filtering by Core rarity returned zero cards.
- Creator view counts ignored every photo and video view.
- A creator's rank disagreed with her Hall of Fame position.
- Video runtime showed about a minute for entire collections.
- Photo views under 2 seconds logged no time at all.
- Daily quest rewards vanished if you didn't claim them before midnight.
- Finishing a session never counted an orgasm anywhere. It now counts on whatever is on screen — and on panel/playlist layouts, on the previous shot per panel too.
- Playlists view had no session button at all.
